impact.text: This will make the side's tree to grow to a non intended size with very many non competitive orders that should be removed to  give room for new ones.

precondition_sources.text: The ask side tree has reached maxNumLimitsPerSide, the threshold from which non competitive orders should be removed on addition of new orders.
The worst price limit queue contains more than one order.
The new order being added introduces a new limit/price queue.

intent_sources.text: When maxNumLimitsPerSide is reached, addition of new orders must remove the non competitive orders so the side's tree does not exceed the intended size.
